entries.title: Gateway host missing from chart values
entries.root_cause: The deployment values omit gateway.publicHost, which the ingress template requires. Supply the public host in the values used by the release.

entries.title: Metrics port missing from chart values
entries.root_cause: The deployment values omit telemetry.listenPort, which the service template requires. Supply the telemetry listen port in the values used by the release.
entries.differs_from_earlier: The same Helm required-value error now names telemetry.listenPort in the service template, requiring a different value to be supplied.

entries.title: Gateway host missing from chart values

entries.root_cause: The deployment values omit telemetry.listenPort, which the service template requires. Supply the telemetry listen port in the values used by the release.
